articles.title: Myanmar airstrike on Karen damages homes in Thailand
articles.description: MAE HONG SON - Blast waves from a Myanmar military airstrike targeting Karen forces near the border damaged at least 17 homes and several public buildings across the Salween River in Thailand's tambon Mae Sam Lap of Sob Moei district, local offiials said.
